summary: One blocking defect: the FR-004 stall cap is unreachable in real worktree runs because the commit provenance moves with every writer commit; plus an export-failure ordering bug and minor reuse/dedupe issues.

findings.summary: Stall cap never reaches 3 in a real worktree run: each issue's `commit` is the worktree HEAD, and every writer call (ledger-add/issue-add) itself commits state, so consecutive partial returns never share a commit.
findings.evidence: ENG-1/ENG-18, FR-004. overrun_issue() and cmd_issue_add() default commit to worktree_head(worktree); commit_worktree() then creates a 'factory: ledger-add' commit, moving HEAD. Reproduced: 4 consecutive `ledger-add implement code-build --overrun ... --partial-return` stored commits c97f85e, 61b8ff7, 4efde6d, fa0db7a; stalls.consecutive_no_commit == 1, halt false each time. stall_rule() (line 725) breaks on any differing commit. Stall tests always pass explicit --commit aaa0001.
findings.fix: Record provenance writer commits do not move (latest non-`factory:` commit), via one helper used by overrun_issue and cmd_issue_add. Test three real ledger-add --partial-return calls without --commit -> halt true on third; a work commit between resets.

findings.summary: Run-end backlog export runs after status write and commit; its OSError is unhandled, leaving an ended run with no backlog and a raw traceback.
findings.evidence: ENG-17. With ${FACTORY_HOME}/improvements as a file: `set-status aborted` FileExistsError traceback, state already aborted; rerun refused 'no run to write from'.
findings.fix: Catch OSError around export, report via die()/warning; export before final status commit or allow re-export. Test the failure path.

findings.summary: ledger-add dedupe key includes commit: never matches in worktree runs; in worktree-less runs (commit None) drops a genuine second overrun of same stage/role.
findings.evidence: ENG-1/ENG-19, FR-006. append_issue(..., dedupe=(stage, role, commit, 'overrun')). Only dedupe test is single-call.
findings.fix: Remove cross-call dedupe or key on spawn identity (started_at/ended_at); add two-call test.

findings.summary: partial_return mark rule and issue record shape duplicated in cmd_issue_add, overrun_issue and state._check_issues.
findings.evidence: ENG-6. Same message and 9-key dict in three places.

findings.summary: Temp-file + os.replace atomic JSON write copied in export, claim, state.write_state and lock.py.
